name: Abu Ali Al-Hashmi
bio: A distinguished Civil Engineer with 30+ years (UAE & Europe) of extensive experience in EPC and FEED projects across the Oil & Gas (Onshore & Offshore), Infrastructure, and Industrial sectors. Proven expertise in leading brownfield and greenfield developments, engineering management, project execution, contract review, procurement, and multidisciplinary team leadership. An experienced strategic leader with strong technical and commercial acumen, supporting complex projects from engineering through execution. Approved Practicing Civil Engineer with Abu Dhabi Municipality, ADNOC and Sharjah Municipality.

name: Sudarshan Das
bio: A dynamic Structural Engineer with 15+ years of UAE experience across complex EPC, FEED, and Engineering Consultancy projects. Extensive expertise in structural analysis, design, detailing, and construction supervision, covering bridges, viaducts, interchanges, tunnels, utilities, hydraulic structures, hydrocarbon tanks, horizontal vessels, pipe rack foundations, buildings, and villas. Proven track record in building and leading multidisciplinary technical teams, managing complex projects, and delivering innovative engineering solutions across diverse sectors. Recognized for strong technical leadership, project management capabilities, and the ability to engage, influence, and collaborate effectively with C-level executives and key stakeholders. Approved Practicing Structural Engineer with Abu Dhabi Municipality, Dubai Municipality, Dubai Development Authority, Trakhees, Nakheel, JAFZA, RTA, Sharjah Municipality, and SRTA.

name: Medhat Elmoursy
bio: Experienced General Manager with 25+ years (UAE) extensive expertise across Legal, Finance, Auditing, Commercial, Regulatory, and Corporate Affairs functions. Proven track record in contract management, regulatory compliance, financial governance, risk management, corporate governance, and stakeholder relations, providing strategic legal and business guidance to support organizational objectives. Highly skilled in navigating complex legal, financial, and regulatory environments while aligning business objectives with robust governance and compliance frameworks. Adept at identifying and mitigating legal, financial, and operational risks, strengthening corporate governance, managing corporate affairs, and ensuring regulatory compliance to enable seamless business operations and sustainable organizational growth. CPA (USA) – Approved Professional.

name: Jessica Morgan
bio: An accomplished Principal Architect and Associate Design Head with 15+ years (USA) experience, specializing in architecture, concept design, design development, urban planning, landscape design, and interior design. Proven ability to lead high-profile residential, commercial, mixed-use, and high-class living projects, creating iconic architectural marvels that blend innovation, functionality, aesthetics, and sustainability. A Registered Professional Engineer in New York City, with expertise in leading multidisciplinary teams and delivering landmark projects aligned with global design standards, regulatory requirements, and client expectations.

name: Prabhu Ponnuswamy
role: Technical Director (Member of Board of Directors)
bio: A highly experienced Structural Engineer with 20+ years (UAE) experience across the Architecture, Engineering & Construction (AEC) and EPC industries, specializing in high-rise buildings, industrial facilities, critical infrastructure, Oil & Gas, petrochemical, and energy projects across the UAE and Middle East. Approved Practicing Structural Engineer with Abu Dhabi Municipality, Dubai Municipality, Dubai Development Authority, Trakhees, Nakheel, JAFZA, ADNOC. Proven expertise in blast-resistant structures, protective buildings, process facilities, pipe racks, equipment structures, industrial steel and reinforced concrete structures, foundations, power facilities, and high-rise residential and commercial developments.

name: Prakash Suresh
bio: A results-driven Engineering Manager with 15+ years (UAE) experience across high-rise buildings, utilities and infrastructure, residential, industrial, and energy projects. Proven expertise in leading multidisciplinary engineering teams and managing complex design and engineering projects across Oil & Gas, petrochemical, power, chemicals & fuels, and conventional and low-carbon energy sectors. Strong technical leadership in wet utility networks, pumping stations, Energy Transfer Stations (ETS), substations, and manufacturing facilities, with strong knowledge of local authority approvals. An Approved Practicing Mechanical Engineer with Abu Dhabi Municipality, Dubai Municipality, Dubai Civil Defense, Abu Dhabi Civil Defense, and ADNOC, focused on delivering safe, efficient, and practical engineering solutions aligned with project requirements, international standards, and client expectations.

name: Chanda Waseem
bio: A strategic HR Manager with 20+ years (UAE) experience across multinational organizations, specializing in talent acquisition, high-performing team development, employee engagement, and organizational growth. Proven expertise in workforce planning, payroll management, employee relations, compensation & benefits, performance management, and employee welfare. Strong knowledge of HR policies, compliance with UAE Labour Laws, and office administration, with a proven ability to strengthen HR operations, retain top talent, and drive operational excellence through effective people leadership.

name: Muhammad Haider Waheed
bio: IT professional with 10+ years of experience managing infrastructure, networks, systems, and digital operations. Skilled in cybersecurity, system optimization, and delivering reliable technology solutions that support business growth. Committed to implementing innovative technologies that improve efficiency, security, and overall business operations.

name: Shaji Sampath
bio: A seasoned Finance Manager with 25+ years (UAE) extensive experience across Finance, Accounting, Audit, Taxation, Budgeting, and Financial Reporting & Controls. Proven expertise in managing financial operations across the Oil & Gas, Energy, Engineering, and Industrial sectors, with strong capabilities in financial planning, cost control, compliance, and risk management. Skilled in strengthening financial governance, optimizing business performance, and providing strategic financial insights to support sound decision-making, operational efficiency, and sustainable organizational growth.
